viewing_method: All four paired sheets, native 512px source previews; original images retained unchanged

observations.observation: Both variants produce a large dark pixel silhouette with little internal flower detail; the 4B output adds a small yellow mark. This is not evidence of semantic or spatial parity.

OPEN is legible above a stack of books in both. The 8B preview has a transparent surrounding area while the 4B output has an opaque studio background. Both show several books despite the singular wording.
Bicycle and sailing boat overlap in both. The 4B bicycle/frame and sail placement are more deformed; neither image demonstrates clean separated left/right placement.
Both contain a bicycle and flowers, with different scale and arrangement. The 4B foreground flower is much larger and the frame/wheels are less coherent.

conclusion: Some subjects and typography are preserved, but the outputs are visibly different; these four historical pairs do not prove 8B parity or perfect positions. They do not measure the new FP8 DiT.
